bounded_checks.findings:
🟢 Published Methods: DAPI-negative live single cells are sorted into384wellplates containing mineral oil,uniquely barcoded RT primers,dNTPs,spike-ins and RNase inhibitor. Plates are spun/storedminus80°C;cells lyse65°C5min. RT42°C and second-strand synthesis16°C precede proteinaseK access to genomicDNA and nestedGFP PCR. The secondPCR introduces separate scarwellbarcodes. Original gDNA-only branch omits step1 (RT/secondstrand).

🟢 All wells are physically pooled,aqueous material is separated from oil,and the recovered mixture is allocated to scar and transcriptome libraries. This is an aliquot split,not DNA/RNA purification. Transcriptomes follow SORT-seq;Fig1d explicitly labelsIVT on pooledcDNA. Exact linked SORT-seq operational continuation remains unreviewed. Scar adapterPCR introduces IlluminaTruSeqadapters;source reports paired-end75bp NextSeq. No new cleanups invented between these stated operations.

🟢 PublishedTable1 first RTprimer is `GCCGGTAATACGACTCACTATAGGCCTTGGCACCCGAGAATTCCANNNNNNNNCGTCTAATTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTVN`;the explicit Barcode column is `CGTCTAAT`. Main transcriptomeanalysis identifiesRead1cellbarcode/UMI andRead2biological information. The8Nsegment is assigned UMI semantics with that source context;the25T+VNanchor is not another identifier. Table2 first scarbarcode `GTCACCGG` is separate from RNAbarcode and inherited GFPscar;its fixed GFP arm is `AGGACGACGGCAACTACAAG`. The adjacent Table2 pieces are not silently joined into a validated wholeprimer.

🟢 Histone-GFP recorder scars can occur in multiple transgene copies per cell. The local lineage feature describes inherited allele information,not a unique currentcell identifier,randommolecule UMI or a predicted indel string. Recorder creation remains upstream of actual NGS recovery. Computational clone filtering does not physically remove molecules in the graph.

Ancestry: published Methods expressly directs the transcriptome branch to SORT-seq (reference18) and gives a detailed Single-cellScarTrace ProtocolExchange original (reference33,10.1038/protex.2018.017). This is branch-specific operational inheritance,not identity with LINNAEUS/scGESTALT. Both directly linked recipes remain deferred under the three-original cap.

bounded_checks.findings: The current graph is an illustrative example of one symbolic well, not a reconstructed experimental sample or verified 384-cell pool. Published Figure 1d schematizes 80% transcriptome and 20% scar branches; the inspected main Methods do not specify transfer amounts. This is a split of the pooled aqueous mixture, not purification of DNA from RNA. The selected source RT primer and scar-primer component inventory remain distinct; adjacent scar-primer columns are not silently assembled. Source mineral-oil/dNTP/spike-in/RNase-inhibitor supplies are molecular allocations, and the thermal/storage programme is a condition, rather than both being enzyme catalysts. RT now has an explicit catalyst allocation without importing an unreviewed SORT-seq enzyme identity or dose. The literal reviewed inventory leaves SORT-seq library manufacture unaccounted. Original required item `unassembled` remains unchanged and uncovered: the detailed ScarTrace Protocol Exchange original and SORT-seq predecessor, full nested/adaptor PCR, and molecular/read assembly still require follow-up. Both joint and gDNA-only graphs remain private.
